# SchoolBridge Afghanistan (پل آموزش افغانستان)

> Digital data portal for Afghanistan's schools — connecting teachers, principals, district, province, and ministry tiers to digitize and submit education statistics, reports, and forms to the central Ministry of Education.

The platform replaces paper-based data transfer with a hierarchical, role-based system. Schools submit statistics; districts and provinces verify and approve; the ministry oversees the national rollup. UI is in Dari (Persian) with full RTL support.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the portal, mission, and national education statistics.
- [Login](/login): Sign in or create an account for school, district, province, or ministry roles.
- [Afghanistan Info](/afghanistan-info): Background on Afghanistan's education system and the portal's national context.
- [Demo](/demo): Interactive demo of the portal's hierarchical workflow.

- [Reset Password](/reset-password): Account password reset flow.
